Abstract: A cloud-based Attendance Management System utilizing facial recognition and GPS tagging to ensure accurate student/employee tracking. Designed to replace manual registers with a tamper-proof digital system.
Objectives:
1. Eliminate proxy attendance.
2. Real-time reporting.
3. Integration with notification systems.
4. Scalable data management.
Modules:
1. Biometric/Face ID Module
2. User Portal
3. Reporting Engine
4. Mobile Application
Viva Questions:
Q: Why is biometric better than manual?
A: It prevents fraud and provides instant data for analytics.
